answer: The falcon index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the cedar queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1898 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the umber. A 162 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
